children: The Board of Directors of Northwest Natural Holding Company

has declared a quarterly dividend of 50 cents per share on the Company’s common stock. The Company's indicated annual dividend rate is $2.00 per share, a 3-cent increase from the previous annual rate of $1.97 per share. This marks the Company’s 71st consecutive year of increasing shareholder dividends and the largest declared increase since 2012.

“Strong execution provided the flexibility to increase the dividend at a higher rate than recent years while positioning us to meet our targeted payout ratio,” said Ray Kaszuba, Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer. “We remain committed to balancing disciplined investment in the business while returning capital to shareholders.”

The Company’s dividend is evaluated annually based on capital requirements and financial performance, subject to approval by the Board of Directors. Over the long term, NW Natural Holdings expects dividend increases to be supported by earnings growth while maintaining a target payout ratio of 55% – 65% of earnings per share.
The dividend will be paid on Nov. 13, 2026, to shareholders of record on Oct. 30, 2026.

It owns Northwest Natural Gas Company (NW Natural), the Company's long-standing natural gas utility serving the Pacific Northwest; SiEnergy Operating, LLC (SiEnergy), a fast-growing natural gas utility serving key Texas markets; NW Natural Water Company (NW Natural Water), an expanding water and wastewater utility; and additional business interests. Together, NW Natural Holdings provides essential energy and water services to nearly one million customers across seven states. The Company has a longstanding commitment to safety, environmental stewardship and supporting its employees and communities, and consistently leads the industry in J.D. Power customer satisfaction. Additional information is available at nwnaturalholdings.com.
